# Configuration

File: `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/kde-win11/settings.json`. Only keys you change are stored; everything else follows the defaults below. Nested keys are written as nested objects:

```json
{
    "schemaVersion": 1,
    "values": {
        "accent": {
            "color": "#ff8c00"
        },
        "taskbar": {
            "alignment": "left"
        }
    }
}
```

Rebuild and install with `tools/install.sh` after editing. Invalid values are ignored, printed as `settings.invalid` and the build continues with the default.
